title: In-Person Appointments Deposit Refunds: Confirmed Attendance and the No-Show Fee Offset
content:
**Q. On a missed In-Person Appointments visit, does the patient's confirmation of attendance change the no-show fee the refund offsets?**

Yes:

- where the patient confirmed the missed visit **2 days or fewer** before its scheduled date, **25.00** dollars are added to the no-show fee the refund offsets;
- where the patient confirmed it **more than 2 days** before its scheduled date, **15.00** dollars are added;
- where the patient never confirmed it, nothing is added.

**Q. Which date shows the confirmation?**

The confirmation date on the appointment record: the date the patient confirmed attendance in answer to a reminder. The days are counted from that date to the scheduled date.

**Q. What about a confirmation on the day of the visit itself?**

That is 0 days before the scheduled date, which is 2 days or fewer, so 25.00 dollars are added.

**Q. Examples at the line?** (hypothetical, scheduled date 2026-10-16)

| Confirmed on | Days before | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-14 | 2 | 25.00 dollars |
| 2026-10-13 | 3 | 15.00 dollars |
| not confirmed | not applicable | nothing |
